verses.text: About the times and seasons, brothers and sisters, you don't need us to write to you.
You know very well that the day of the Lord will come like a thief in the night.
While people are saying, ‘Peace and safety,’ sudden destruction will come on them, like labor pains on a pregnant woman, and they won't escape.
But you, brothers and sisters, aren't in the dark, so that this day could catch you like a thief.
You are all children of light and children of the day. We don't belong to the night or the darkness.
So let's not sleep like everyone else. Let's stay alert and clear-minded.
Those who sleep, sleep at night, and those who get drunk, get drunk at night.
But since we belong to the day, let's be clear-minded, putting on faith and love as a breastplate and the hope of salvation as a helmet.
God didn't choose us for judgment but to receive salvation through our Lord Jesus Christ.
He died for us so that, whether we're awake or asleep, we may live together with him.
So encourage one another and build each other up, just as you're already doing.
Brothers and sisters, respect those who work among you, lead you in the Lord, and correct you.
Hold them in high regard and love because of their work. Live at peace with one another.
We urge you, brothers and sisters: warn those who are idle, encourage the discouraged, help the weak, and be patient with everyone.
Make sure no one pays back evil for evil. Always pursue what is good for one another and for everyone.
Always be joyful.
Never stop praying.
Give thanks in every situation, because this is God's will for you in Christ Jesus.
Don't put out the Spirit's fire.
Don't treat prophecies with contempt.
Test everything. Hold on to what is good.
Stay away from every kind of evil.
May the God of peace himself make you completely holy. May your whole spirit, soul, and body be kept blameless when our Lord Jesus Christ comes.
The one who calls you is faithful, and he will do it.
Brothers and sisters, pray for us.
Greet all the believers with a holy kiss.
I charge you before the Lord to have this letter read to all the brothers and sisters.
May the grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you. Amen.
